name: Churrito Loco
facts: Churrito Loco is at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.
The app has a free 90-second match-3 game called Loco Match.
Loco Match is free to play as often as you like, with no account needed.
A free account (name, phone, email) is needed only to save a score or claim a prize.
Weekly board runs Monday through Sunday and resets every Monday.
Sample prizes: 1st place 50% off your next order, 2nd place 20% off, a 4,150+ run 15% off.
Free Daily Spin: one spin per member per day, every slice wins something.
Rewards ladder: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1,100 pts Churros for the table.
Spin food prizes are good for 3 days at the South Gate location, one reward per visit.
Menu has Churros, Street Corn & Fries, Dogs and Drinks.
No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win.
One account per person and per phone.
You must be 13 or older; under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: How late are you open on Friday and Saturday?
qa.a: Fri and Sat we're open until 11:00p, starting at 12:00p.
We open at 12:00p (noon) every day of the week.
2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps.
Tap the Directions button in the app and it opens Google Maps to our address.
I don't have parking details. Please ask staff when you get here.
I don't have a phone number to show here. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call in an order?
qa.a: The app has a Call to order button, but I don't have the number to share here. Ask staff at the counter for ordering help.

qa.q: Can I order from my table or by QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table ordering. The full menu is in the app, so ask staff how to place your order.
I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you have a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff.
I don't have reservation info. Please ask staff at the counter.
We have Churros, Street Corn & Fries, Dogs and Drinks. Scroll the Menu in the app to see everything.
Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49 and the Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry or chocolate.

qa.q: What are the plain churros like?
qa.a: Plain Signature Churros come 4 to an order, rolled in cinnamon sugar, for $7.99.
Churro Bites Filled (10pc) are mini filled churros with your choice of fillings, $9.49.

qa.q: What is the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: It's a cone made out of churro with ice cream, drizzle and topping. $9.49.

qa.q: What street corn do you have?
qa.a: Original Corn (whole corn, mayo, cheese, butter, chili powder) is $7.49. Hot Cheetos Corn (mayo, butter, hot Cheeto crumbs) is $7.49.
Original Elote Fries are $11.49, topped with corn mixed in mayo, cheese and butter. XL Chili Cheese Fries are $16.49, with chili, cheese and grilled onions.

qa.q: What hot dogs do you have?
qa.a: Flamin Dog ($9.49) is an all-beef dog with bacon, nacho cheese and hot Cheeto crumbs. Churro Dog ($9.49) is an all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese.
Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee $6.49, Watermelon Paleta Energy $7.99, Jamaica Agua Fresca $5.49 and Pumpkin Spice Horchata $8.49.

qa.q: What is the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: It's a watermelon, chamoy and tajín mix with Red Bull. $7.99.

qa.q: What is the Jamaica Agua Fresca?
qa.a: A hibiscus-flavored drink, $5.49.
No alcohol is shown on our menu in the app.
The prices come from our public menu and may change. Confirm in store.
Yes, the app shows seasonal specials built from our menu. Open the Specials card to see what's on now and what's coming.
The Hot Cheetos Spooky Combo: Hot Cheetos Corn + Filled Churros (2pc), shown Oct 20–31 with code BOO.
The Pumpkin Spice Pair: Pumpkin Spice Horchata + Plain Signature Churros (4pc), shown Nov 20–28.
The Holiday Churro Box: Churro Bites Filled (10pc) + an Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee, shown Dec 15–25.
New Year's Loaded Share: XL Chili Cheese Fries + Churro Bites Filled (10pc), shown Dec 29–Jan 1.
Churro Date: two Churro Ice Cream Cones, shown Feb 7–14.

qa.q: What are the St. Patrick's, Cinco and Fourth of July specials?
qa.a: Lucky Elote Fries (Original Elote Fries + Watermelon Paleta Energy, Mar 14–17), Cinco Street Combo (Flamin Dog + Original Corn + Jamaica Agua Fresca, May 1–5) and Fourth of July Churro Dog (Churro Dog + Watermelon Paleta Energy, Jul 1–4).
The app doesn't show special prices. Ask staff for the price.
It's our free 90-second match-3 puzzle game. Line up 3 or more of the same snack to score, and a high score can win a prize.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap, or swipe a snack toward its neighbor. Swaps only stick if they make a match of 3 or more.
Each run is 90 seconds.
Each snack in a match is worth +10. A 4-in-a-row adds +40, a 5-in-a-row adds +100, and clearing the Churrito Man adds +150.
When falling snacks match again on their own, you get bonus points: +15, +30, +45 and so on for each step.
He's our churro mascot in the game. Make a match right next to him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano and why avoid it?
qa.a: The grilled Serrano is a hazard. Swiping it costs you 25 points. Leave it alone, it burns out by itself.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: Once per run, a golden Antidote tile appears. Make a match right next to it for +300.
Antidote The Foodie reviewed Churrito Loco on YouTube. After a run where you find his tile, the app links to his review.

qa.q: Which snacks are in the game?
qa.a: Elote, XL Chili Cheese Fries, Filled Churros, Abuelita Choco Horchata and a Sandía (watermelon) drink. Each is +10 in a match.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is free for anyone, with no account needed. You only need one to save a score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to play?
qa.a: No. No purchase or payment of any kind is needed to play, and buying food doesn't improve your chances.
As often as you like. The game is free with no daily limit.

qa.q: Is Loco Match luck or skill?
qa.a: It's a game of skill. Prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board, not on chance.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. The board resets every Monday, so there are new winners each week.

qa.q: What do I win on the weekly board?
qa.a: Sample prizes: 1st place gets 50% off your next order and 2nd place gets 20% off. The real prizes are set by the restaurant.

qa.q: What score do I need for a prize?
qa.a: A single run of 4,150 points or more earns 15% off your next order and a spot on the weekly board. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: What happens if two people tie?
qa.a: Ties go to the score that was posted first.
The week runs Monday through Sunday close, and the board resets every Monday. I don't have an exact pickup time, so ask staff.

qa.q: How do I claim a prize?
qa.a: Join with a free account to save your score, then show the code on your phone and your matching account at the counter.
Food prizes and discounts from the spin are good for 3 days at our South Gate location, one reward per visit. I don't have an expiry for game discounts, so ask staff.
No. Food prizes and discounts can't be combined with other rewards, and it's one reward per visit.
Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.
Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Controllers like Xbox, PlayStation and Switch Pro work in most browsers. Pair it, press any button, then use the Help link in the game.
After about 80–90 seconds of total play, the next run opens with a short break showing Antidote's review reel. You can skip it or go back to the game.
A free wheel you can spin once a day. Every slice wins something, from reward points to free food.
One spin per member per day, on Los Angeles time. Spins are never sold and can't be earned by buying.

qa.q: What can I win on the spin?
qa.a: +50 points (30%), +100 points (20%), +75 points (15%), $1 off any churro (15%), Free churro (8%), Free horchata (7%) or 10% off your order (5%).
No. No prize includes alcohol. The free horchata is non-alcoholic.

qa.q: Do I need an account to spin?
qa.a: The spin is for members. Join with a free account to use it.

qa.q: How do I join Churrito Loco Rewards?
qa.a: Sign up free with your name, phone number and email. It takes a minute, and the app also invites you to join after a game run.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The app shows a welcome offer of a free churro with your next order. Ask staff how to use it.
Legal U.S. residents 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. One free account per person and per phone.
You earn points from Daily Spin wins and from purchases. I don't have the exact points-per-dollar ratio, so ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have a points-per-dollar number. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do I get points for playing the game?
qa.a: I don't have game points listed. Game prizes are discounts based on your score and weekly rank.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro and 1,100 pts Churros for the table.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and show the code on your phone and your matching account at the counter.

qa.q: Do points expire or have cash value?
qa.a: Points have no cash value. I don't have an expiry rule, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have level details for Churrito Loco. Ask staff.
I don't have birthday reward details. Ask staff.
Yes, the app has a referral reward: a free churro. I don't have the exact steps, so ask staff or check Ways to earn in the app.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for showing the app at the counter?
qa.a: The app shows an offer for double stars on today's churros when you show it at the counter. Confirm with staff that it's running.

qa.q: Do I get anything for visiting nearby?
qa.a: If you turn on location, the app shows how far you are and may give a heads-up when you're within 2 miles. Your location stays on your phone.
Tokens are not turned on right now, and Loco Match is free. If they're added later, a play would cost 10 tokens, with free tokens weekly and daily.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the 🌐 button for English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский.
I don't have a kids mode. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission to have an account.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android Chrome tap the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen or Install. There's also an Add to Home Screen link in the app.

qa.q: Do I need to download anything?
qa.a: No. It works in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your Home Screen to open like an app.
Yes, the app has a Google review button. Honest reviews only, and no points or prizes are given for reviewing.
Our Instagram is @churritoloco, and the app shows our latest posts and reels.

qa.q: What do you do with my information?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Texts and emails are opt-in, and you can stop them anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Why do you ask for my phone number?
qa.a: An account is tied to the phone it was made on, and the live app confirms your number with a text code. That keeps it to one account per person and phone.
Only if you opt in. Marketing texts are optional, and you can stop them anytime by replying STOP.

qa.q: I need help, who do I ask?
qa.a: Ask any staff member at the counter. I don't have a phone number to share here.

qa.q: Can I change my order or have a problem fixed?
qa.a: I can't see orders. Please ask staff at the counter.
